data.title: Summer Mission
data.shortDescription: Make a lasting impact through service together.
data.fullDescription: Summer Mission is an impactful outreach program where participants dedicate their time, energy, and skills to serve communities and share hope. Throughout the mission, volunteers engage in activities such as community service, evangelism, teaching, prayer, and practical support for those in need. This mission experience encourages spiritual growth, strengthens teamwork, and develops leadership while allowing participants to live out their faith through action. It is a time to step beyond comfort zones, build meaningful connections, and bring lasting change to lives during the summer season.

data.title: Manuscript
data.shortDescription: Dive into God’s Word and grow in faith.
data.fullDescription: Manuscript is a focused Bible study designed to deepen your understanding of Scripture and strengthen your relationship with God. Join us as we explore God’s Word together, discuss its meaning, and apply its lessons to everyday life. This is a time for reflection, learning, and fellowship with fellow believers, helping each participant grow spiritually and gain practical insights for living out their faith. Come prepared with your Bible and an open heart to engage, learn, and be inspired.

data.title: Monday Service
data.shortDescription: Join us for worship, fellowship, and God’s word.
data.fullDescription: Monday Service is a time to gather as a community for worship, prayer, and teaching from God’s word. The service runs from 11:00 AM to 2:30 PM, and participants are encouraged to come with their Bibles and open hearts. It’s an opportunity to connect with God, grow spiritually, and build meaningful relationships with fellow believers. Expect inspiring messages, uplifting worship, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere where everyone can encounter God and be refreshed for the week ahead.

data.title: Charity Drive
data.fullDescription: Charity Drive is a meaningful initiative focused on bringing hope and practical support to those in need. Through this drive, we come together as a community to give generously, share resources, and demonstrate love through action. Every contribution—big or small—helps us reach our goal of providing food, clothing, financial assistance, and essential supplies to individuals and families facing hardship. This is more than a donation; it is an opportunity to make a real difference, serve with compassion, and reflect kindness where it is needed most. Join us as we work together to uplift lives and create lasting impact.

data.title: Evange Vs. BS
data.shortDescription: Cheer, compete, and celebrate in faith and fellowship!
data.fullDescription: Evange vs. BS is an exciting football match bringing together Christian players and fans for a day of friendly competition, teamwork, and fellowship. Beyond the thrill of the game, this event is a chance to build community, encourage one another, and celebrate sportsmanship in a faith-filled environment. Come support your team, enjoy fun activities, and share in the joy of healthy competition while strengthening bonds within the Christian community.

data.title: Annual Youth Camp
data.shortDescription: Join us for 3 days of worship.
data.fullDescription: Annual Youth Camp is an unforgettable three-day spiritual experience created to ignite faith, deepen your relationship with God, and unite young people in worship and fellowship. Throughout the camp, participants will engage in powerful worship sessions, life-changing messages, focused prayer times, interactive workshops, and meaningful group discussions. Beyond the teachings, the camp offers moments of joy through games, team activities, and shared experiences that build strong friendships and community. This is a sacred time to step away from everyday routines, encounter God in a deeper way, grow in spiritual maturity, and be equipped to impact your church, school, and society. Come with expectation and leave renewed, inspired, and empowered.

data.title: I4U Night
data.shortDescription: Give, celebrate, and make a difference together.
data.fullDescription: I4U Night is a special charity evening dedicated to giving hope and support to those in need. Through music, fellowship, and acts of generosity, participants come together to make a tangible impact in the lives of others. This night is an opportunity to celebrate community, serve with compassion, and experience the joy of giving. Join us for an inspiring evening where every contribution—big or small—helps transform lives and spreads love to those who need it most.

data.title: Weekly Bible Study
data.shortDescription: A weekly gathering to study and reflect on God’s Word together.
data.fullDescription: Join us every week as we dive deeper into the Bible, discuss key passages, share insights, and encourage one another in faith. Everyone is welcome, whether you are new to Bible study or have been studying for years.
